Build me a personal portfolio website with:
- A hero section with my name and a short tagline
- An about section describing my background
- A contact section with an email link and social
  media icons
Use a clean, modern design with good spacing.
My name is Marcus Webb, I'm a UX/UI Designer, and I want the site to feel minimal and refined.

Phase 1 — running logo, fonts, and colors in parallel.Fonts and colors applied. Now generating the logo.Logo generated. Now building Header and Footer in parallel.Now building Header and Footer simultaneously.Now building the homepage — the main event.

Looks great! The site is exactly the kind of clean, professional look I was going for. I'm happy with it as is.

DONE

Your portfolio is live and looking sharp, Marcus. The minimal, editorial design with the oversized hero type, warm terracotta accents, and refined typography is all in place — exactly the kind of presence a UX/UI designer should have online.
